task.news: Nela moved the radio programme from Tuesday to Wednesday. The broadcast time, duration and reception are unchanged.
task.expressive: A little change in the weekly rhythm! Update the listing so everyone finds the programme on Wednesday.
task.restrained: The programme now airs on Wednesday. Update the listing so everyone finds the programme on Wednesday.
task.user: Nela moved the radio programme from Tuesday to Wednesday. The broadcast time, duration and reception are unchanged. Respond to this update and suggest one practical next step. Use two sentences.

response: The change in broadcast day shouldn't affect the programme's reach, as the time, duration, and reception remain the same. A practical next step would be to update all promotional materials and notify listeners of the new schedule.
